findings.claim: The three restored-pool tests bind maxResults to the SPEC_SEARCH_POOL constant, so they pin 'the request is the pool, not the cap' but cannot detect a change to the constant itself; the contract clause 'restored EXACTLY 20/15/20' rests on review, not on the suite.
findings.counterexample: Grep across packages/** finds three definitions and three test references of SPEC_SEARCH_POOL and no literal 20/15 pin; editing spec.ts:51 from 20 to 5 leaves spec.test.ts:479, shield-retrieve.test.ts:94 and triage-retrieve.test.ts:93 green.

findings.claim: Two new tests are titled 'delivers the top-MAX_SPEC_RESULTS specs by score, in score order' but neither shield nor triage sorts; the assertion proves first-N-as-returned, not top-N-by-score.
findings.counterexample: shield.ts:83 and triage.ts:83 are a bare allSpecs.slice(0, MAX_SPEC_RESULTS) with no sort; the fixtures feed descending scores so slice trivially satisfies the name. Same shape at triage-retrieve.test.ts:96.

findings.claim: Excluding lessons from the floor creates a new reachable contradiction between the count line and the refusal text: the run prints N lessons and is then refused as 'nothing in the index grounds this run'; the behaviour is tested, the message is not, and no failure-mode row covers the text.
findings.counterexample: On a free-text non---raw run against an index holding lessons but returning 0 specs / 0 sessions / 0 code, spec.ts:959 prints 'Found: 0 specs, 0 sessions, 0 code, 10 lessons' and spec.ts:736 then prints 'Retrieval returned 0 hits - nothing in the index grounds this run.' Unreachable at 19e08f56 because lessons were always empty.

findings.claim: The evidence paragraph presents 0/55 and 56/56 as a matched before/after pair while the denominators differ, and the only committed denominator is 55; the shift is real but unexplained.
findings.counterexample: .totem/fixtures/spec-runs-2026-09-02/r1-queries.ndjson is 55 lines and r1-results.md:3 says 'over 55 queries', while the harness derives its corpus from the resident's live artifact dir (r1-retrieve.mjs:163-164), so 55 to 56 is expected growth the sentence never names.

findings.claim: The design record's live-falsifier line was not folded with the changeset: it still says '--resident <this worktree>' and '55 recorded queries' where the changeset says the resident index and 56.
findings.counterexample: r1-retrieve.mjs:11 documents the invocation as '--resident D:/Dev/totem'; two surfaces in one slice disagree on both the replay target and the denominator.

findings.claim: The helper has no test in the package that owns it; its direct unit tests live in the CLI and resolve @mmnto/totem to core's BUILT dist, so the design record's 'the helper's test pins the type' invariant is build-order dependent.
findings.counterexample: packages/core/src/store/search-lessons.test.ts does not exist; packages/core/package.json exports '.' maps to ./dist/index.js with no source condition and packages/cli/vitest.config.ts sets no alias, so utils.test.ts:1102-1152 exercises packages/core/dist/index.js. Core covers the spelling only transitively via semantic-dedup.test.ts:124.

findings.claim: The makeLesson factory still mints the pre-mmnto-ai/totem#431 shape (type 'spec' at .totem/lessons.md); the fold corrected one call site and left eight unqualified.
findings.counterexample: spec.test.ts:132-134 defaults filePath '.totem/lessons.md' and type 'spec'; sites at 200, 224, 237, 249, 266, 267, 297 and 311 call makeLesson() bare, seeding a spec-typed row into the lessons array the slice says cannot exist.

findings.claim: The restated JSDoc summary attributes this slice's three-partition scoping to mmnto-ai/totem#2700, which authored the opposite spelling in this same file.
findings.counterexample: 19e08f56:packages/cli/src/commands/spec.ts:643-644 reads 'over ALL items across the four partitions (mmnto-ai/totem#2700)'; the body comment at spec.ts:674-684 correctly credits 2735, but the summary line read alone reports the scoping as 2700's.

verdict: Fold 1 holds: F1 restored exactly (20/15/20 verified against 19e08f56, request-identity tests non-vacuous), F2 complete (zero lesson-seeking 'spec' queries remain across core, cli and mcp; seven sites enumerate correctly; no import-cycle or heavy-package change), F3 behaviourally identical to base since the lesson partition was always empty there, and both gates reproduce exactly (cli 4518/20, core 4287/5, tsc 0, eslint 0, prettier clean) - one MATERIAL evidence-wording issue (the 55-vs-56 replay denominator) and seven MINOR items, none blocking.
